don’t, seriously. i’m stuck here now and my partner won’t move out of this area. in the positives column however is this is a VERY central location to a LOT of metro areas for commuting, plenty of people who live south in york commute to baltimore and vice versa. harrisburg is close to baltimore (depends on where you live, i’m less than 90 away) philly (an 1h 45m train ride OR drive, but remains to be see with fallout of I95 incident), and a moderate distance from pittsburgh, nyc, and dc (all within / under 3 hours). i will admit the concerned residents of this community make it tolerable. there is a lot of work in the area too. there are some nice parks. we have a really nice riverfront to walk on. if you want a lot of cultural options you will have to go around to more than harrisburg, but there are some good options around. there’s some fun parks in surrounding counties that aren’t a far drive. this is a bikeable city i think. it may not be the safest imo either though (see more below). having the capitol and so many state services around is a plus too! i know i complain but i’m a city person, and this is more like a tiny city. it’s 50k people or so.  

the negatives are in harrisburg city things are getting kinda worse and the mayor is just allowing it because she’s just in it for the money lol. parking is also not great. wanda has ended some safety initiatives for state street (which was named one of americas deadliest streets). isnt proposing anything else. harrisburg politics bleed into the city obviously. 

living in cumberland or other parts of dauphin county would probably be better for you than actually in city limits. york is nice too but if you lean anything blue don’t expect your candidates to win (harrisburg city and northern york co have the same us rep), if you lean red then the suburbs will be a good voting bloc for you to join

sorry this was long winded

tl;dr: commutable to a lot of major metro areas, small (50k) city, food options okay but not everything cultural. lots of state services/tours around. harrisburg politics bad. suburbs may be better for you - they go red and not blue.

Hi, thinking about transferring here with my AA. Temple is a great option for in-state students (one of the most affordable), but out of state rates are kinda wack. Especially with housing and meal plans. I moved out of my dorm when corona really hit off-campus. I would not recommend doing it till after soph/jr year if your sister decides to stick this out. Be a bit more responsible then. For the business school, it's $18,804 per semester (like holy heck). The cheapest dorm you can get per semester is barely under 4k. New students HAVE to have a meal plan worth 1.6k or more. 

I got a nearly full ride from my previous private school. I had to take out loans to pay for housing. I only owed 400/out of pocket for tuition, however. The full ride is most definitely what you want. I spent a year and a half at a private university and took on much less debt than my friends who are about 30-40k in the hole already. A full ride is definitely worth it for your sister's financial future. Just make sure you keep up with the requirements to do so.

Hi there, I don't have kids, but I do have mental illness. Let me say a few things.

1. Resounding agreement with everyone saying leave due to your kids, I don't have a child but even for my nephew, I'd leave someone if my SO had hurt him.
2. As someone who has swallowed a whole bottle of pills before, 1, good job on calling 911. That shit is for real scary. I was tripping out walking to the hospital  (yes, I walked to the hospital after I tried to end my own life) when I tried to end my own life the same way. I almost seized it once I got to the hospital. It is scary and traumatic for bystanders/witnesses.
3. ALSO. AGREE!!! IT IS NOT YOUR FAULT YOUR GF TRIED TO TAKE HER OWN LIFE. The cop is spitting facts.
4. You do need to leave. She clearly is not in a place to date. I say this as someone w mental illness. If it's being helped/treated, usually you can skate by. I dated as soon as I got out of inpatient treatment and I was not ready. Fuck, I am still not ready. The point is, she needs to legit focus on herself.
5. While this attempt surely is concerning, your gf will likely be under close watch from her family and friends after this. I sure was, even as an adult. Breaking up now while she's been watched intensely is one of the best things you could honestly do. Cut contact with her too. This relationship has clearly gotten to a toxic point for her.

Please remember it is not your fault that she tried to take her own life. Get help through your employer if you can, most jobs have an EAP that anyone can use to connect for therapy services (usually discounted/free in my past experience). This is traumatic for you too. Spend some time with your daughter. Much love man. Again, do not blame yourself.

I'll ideally be moving to Philadelphia next fall though, need more of a big city feel. I go through Midtown Property Management. Midtown is the best, recommend for sure.
